message.content:
An illustration for a magazine cover features a blue-purple background. In the upper center, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large white capital letters. Below it, smaller white text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". A caricature of a man with brown skin, a wide smile, and folded arms occupies the right side of the frame. His lower body transforms into a trail of white-and-blue ethereal smoke. This smoke trail emerges from the chimney of a small, reddish-brown factory building held in a pair of large, yellow hands at the bottom left. The factory has several yellow windows and sits on a blue surface. 

The top of the cover contains two headlines in white text: "Jika Tentara Menangani Terorisme H.28" and "Pengambilalihan Konsesi Hutan Meluas H.74". Below the large "TEMPO" logo is the title "OLAH-OLAH BAHLIL", followed by a paragraph of smaller white text. In the bottom right corner, there is a date range "19-25 JANUARI 2026", a price "RP 60.000", a website URL, a barcode, and a QR code.
